findings.title: OS Command Injection
findings.trigger: Attacker-controlled data in email_data_str could reach a command interpreter.
findings.assumptions: The code does not show any command execution but the data is being read from an attacker-controlled source and could potentially be used in a command execution elsewhere in the application.

findings.title: Buffer Overflow
findings.trigger: If the size of email_data_str exceeds the allocated buffer size, a buffer overflow could occur.
findings.assumptions: The buffer size is assumed to be fixed and the code does not show any dynamic memory allocation. The size of email_data_str is directly used in memcpy.

findings.title: Information Exposure
findings.trigger: The email body content is printed to the console, potentially exposing sensitive information.
findings.assumptions: The email content might contain sensitive information that should not be exposed to the console.

findings.title: Missing or Weak Error Handling
findings.trigger: No error handling for curl_easy_setopt calls, which could lead to undefined behavior if the options are not set correctly.
findings.assumptions: The code does not show any error handling for curl_easy_setopt calls, which could lead to undefined behavior if the options are not set correctly.
